keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Sporting Braga 1, KuPS 0. Pau Víctor (Sporting Braga) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Gabri Martínez.
Goal! Sporting Braga 2, KuPS 0. Fran Navarro (Sporting Braga) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Pau Víctor.
Samuel Pasanen (KuPS) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Sporting Braga 2, KuPS 0.
Substitution, KuPS. Jorginho replaces Niilo Kujasalo.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Demir Ege Tiknaz replaces Jean-Baptiste Gorby.
Substitution, KuPS. Gustav Engvall replaces Julius Eskesen.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Jovan Milosevic replaces Fran Navarro.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Tomás Marqués replaces João Moutinho.
Valentín Gasc (KuPS) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Bright Arrey-Mbi replaces Adrian Barisic.
Substitution, KuPS. Tommi Jyry replaces Petteri Pennanen.
Substitution, KuPS. Joslyn Luyeye-Lutumba replaces Samuel Pasanen.
Goal! Sporting Braga 3, KuPS 0. Mario Dorgeles (Sporting Braga) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Pau Víctor.
Substitution, Sporting Braga. Flinto Costa replaces Gabri Martínez.

keyEvents.text: Substitution, KuPS. Piotr Parzyszek replaces Jaime Moreno.
Goal! Sporting Braga 4, KuPS 0. Jovan Milosevic (Sporting Braga) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Pau Víctor.
Demir Ege Tiknaz (Sporting Braga) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Sporting Braga 4, KuPS 0.
